articles.summary: Geneva, Ohio —TEGAM, Inc., experts and innovators in temperature measurement, asked the question, “What does ‘Fast Response’ mean for a thermometer temperature probe?” We then answered that question with the arrival of our new, fast-response temperature probe for various industrial applications.
articles.title: TEGAM Announces Fast-Response Temperature Probe – When Time Is of the Essence!

articles.summary: Advanced Energy's TEGAM announces our new Sure Grip Polymer glove to fit the 912 and 911 digital thermometers, 931 and 932 datalogging thermometers, and the 940 Series Thermocouple Calibrators.
articles.title: TEGAM’s SureGrip Polymer Cover for Instrument AND Equipment Protection Adds Innovation
